expires_today.title: And the Winner Is: Award Winning Fantasy, Science Fiction, & Horror from Tachyon
expires_today.long_description: Here at Humble, we only want to give you the best of the best, and for our more discerning readers we’ve crafted a bundle of sci-fi, fantasy, and horror ebooks from Tachyon that aren’t just great reads, but award-winning modern classics! Dive into tales of technology and terror from genre-blending master Peter Watts in his short story collection Beyond the Rift! Wartime history and B-movie schlock combine in James Morrow’s World War II kaiju extravaganza Shambling Towards Hiroshima! An utterly unique voice takes on worlds beyond our own in Ellen Klages’ haunting short story collection Portable Childhoods! There is so much more to discover in this collection of fiction from some of today’s most daring authors, so grab these books while you can at the price of your choice, and support Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Professional Developer Pathways Bundle
expires_today.long_description: Learn practical programming, cloud, and web development skills with the Professional Developer Pathways Bundle. Build real projects with Python, JavaScript, Rust, C++, C#, React, Next.js, Django, Flask, and more while exploring Git & GitHub workflows, SQL databases, AWS and Azure developer skills, and modern AI-powered coding workflows with Claude Code. Pay what you want for a massive software development bundle from Zenva and support Alzheimer’s Research UK while building practical skills for today’s rapidly evolving developer landscape.

expires_today.title: Dungeon Defenders II Complete DLC Chest
expires_today.description: Defend your friends and loot your enemies!
expires_today.long_description:
Are you ready to join the fight for Etheria? If you’re enjoying the free-to-play Dungeon Defenders II and want to level up your game, we’ve got all of the DLC in one bundle at a great discount! Take to the stars with the Celestial Vault Pack, bask in the eldritch glow of the Ethereal Trove Pack, equip your heroes with the Adventurer’s Arsenal Pack, and more! This bundle even includes a Golden Headless Horseman Premium Pet that will plague your enemies with tormented thoughts! Grab this bundle while you can to level up your forces and save your lands from evil, pay whatever price you want, and support coral reef ecosystem nonprofit Coral Guardian with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 8th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Upload VR Summer 2026
expires_today.long_description:
Freshen up your VR collection with an epic bundle of titles perfect for any platform. Jump into the cockpit of a wide variety of aircraft in VTOL VR, a near-futuristic combat flight game built to get your heart pumping! Brave Metro Awakening, a story-driven VR adventure that blends exploration and FPS gameplay to deliver a completely immersive experience. Or get a lil’ strange with Among Us 3D, a new twist on the original game’s formula that drops you into chaos! Step out of reality and into a world of savings—plus, your purchase helps support Kiss the Ground!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 8th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Yuri in Luck: Waifus for Laifus
expires_today.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Find love, companionship, and maybe a little romance with the Yuri in Luck: Waifus for Laifus Bundle—a colorful collection of LGBTQ+-themed yuri titles! Play “Yuri Cupid” in Kindred Spirits on the Roof, a slice-of-life tale of love, loss, lust, and friendship. Lead a romantic cat-and-mouse game with a supernatural spin across a gorgeous watercolor-style backdrop in OshiRabu: Waifus Over Husbandos. Or lose yourself in SeaBed, a deep psychological mystery visual novel told through the perspectives of three unique characters. Plus, your purchase helps support our friends at Dames 4 Games.

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 1st, 2027.

expires_today.title: The 2026 Learn Unity Game Development Bundle
expires_today.description: Unlock your creative side with Unity
expires_today.long_description:
Your new career in game development is only a click away with The 2026 Learn Unity Game Development Bundle! No prior knowledge is needed for this curated collection of lessons from GameDev.tv—just come prepared with a curious mind and a passion for gaming. Get started today and create your own RPG, 2D adventure, and more with courses like Unity Turn Based Strategy Course and Unity Real Time Strategy Course. Get the expert instruction you need from pros in the field, and help support Trees, Water & People with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles should be redeemed before June 25th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Robyn Carr's Virgin River
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Enter a quiet mountain town where things are a lot more complicated than they seem on the surface with this 21-ebook bundle of Robyn Carr’s bestselling Virgin River—the series that inspired the hit Netflix show! Meet a recently widowed nurse as she attempts to fit in with the residents of the remote California town while also caring for an abandoned infant in the very first novel Virgin River. Follow along as a former Marine saves a woman on the run with her young child in Shelter Mountain. Root for the town’s first resident cop as he attempts to settle down with the gal who’s stolen his heart in Whispering Rock. Imagine yourself cozied up by the fire inside the mountain cabin of your dreams with a hot chocolate in one hand and this ebook bundle in the other. Pay what you want for the entire series, and support Room to Read with your purchase!

The titles in this bundle are available through Kobo.com. To access the content, create or log in to your Kobo.com account.

expires_within_72h.title: Sonic 35th Anniversary Megabundle by IDW
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Celebrate 35 years of Sonic the Hedgehog with this megabundle of Sonic comics from IDW! What kinds of mischief have Sonic, his pals, and Dr. Eggman gotten into outside of the video games? Now you can find out! Catch the Blue Blur speeding through the pages of the official Sonic the Hedgehog comic series, collected together in 21 volumes of adventure and fun! Stay up to speed on all the Sonic mini-series like Imposter Syndrome, Tangle & Whisper, and Fang the Hunter! Enjoy all your favorite stories plus all the bonus content featured in Sonic’s 30th Anniversary Deluxe Edition! This bundle is perfect for diehard Sonic fans and newcomers alike, so snag it at the price of your choosing before it speeds away, and support Children’s Miracle Network with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles should be redeemed before July 11, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: June 2unes
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Get the beats bumping and the tunes thumping with this bundle of rhythm games that really jam! Slay monsters with the power of music to find your lost voice in Everhood 2! Toot your own horn and solve the mysteries of the Trombiverse in Trombone Champ! Test your color matching skills and enter the Rhythm Dimension in retro arcade game Spin Rhythm XD! There’s even more music and mayhem to enjoy in this mixtape of our favorite rhythm games, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support StackUp with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 10th, 2027.
